header_summary:
A new proposal aims to improve wallet recovery by embedding BIP39 mnemonics and optional passphrases directly into output script descriptors, facilitating consistent and secure restoration across wallet software. This integration allows full derivation of BIP32 master keys and supports complex key expressions, with details and implementation provided in the [pull request](https://github.com/polespinasa/bips/pull/2) and [Bitcoin Core repository](https://github.com/polespinasa/bitcoin/pull/8).

Developments in post-quantum cryptography include the introduction of Hybrid Key Encapsulation (HKE) for the Elements project, combining secp256k1 ECDH and ML-KEM-768 to ensure IND-CCA security and future-proof key exchange mechanisms as described in the [ELIP proposal](https://github.com/ElementsProject/ELIPs/pull/46). Additionally, a garbled-circuit verifier for hash-based STARK proofs has been implemented for BitVM3-style bridges, significantly reducing storage requirements and bolstering post-quantum resistance, with technical details and source code available at [bitcoin-stark-verifier](https://github.com/GOATNetwork/bitcoin-stark-verifier).

Privacy advancements in BIP352 silent payments are demonstrated by spscand, a watch-only scanner supporting local, oracle-based, and filter-driven block sources; it ensures minimal information leakage and robust privacy, with [source code and documentation](https://github.com/ZenulAbidin/spscand) accessible for further review. For efficient blockchain validation, consensus is growing around adopting per-UTXO Merkle trees and standardized snapshot hashes, facilitating scalable proof generation, periodic proof of reserves, and zero-knowledge validation, as outlined in [BIP452](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0452.mediawiki).

Comprehensive analyses of Bitcoin’s UTXO set at block 975,019 reveal that 35.6% of all unspent BTC resides in outputs with publicly exposed keys or scripts, with detailed exposure rates varying by output type and significant key reuse observed across formats. Extraction rules and their alignment with BIP 362 are discussed in detail at [this documentation](https://github.com/duncan0k/btc-exposure-index/blob/2a0f4b053cad2ae3dc101a4e4c154ac2b4706f25/docs/extraction-rules.md11-relation-to-the-bip-362-draft), highlighting ongoing efforts to refine on-chain privacy and exposure metrics.

recent_posts.title: [BIP Draft] bip39() Descriptor Key Expression
recent_posts.summary:
- A proposal introduces direct mnemonic and passphrase support within output script descriptors for wallet recovery.
- This enables wallets to derive keys and manage complex setups securely and consistently.
- Draft details, initial implementation, and feedback opportunities are available via linked repositories and channels.

recent_posts.title: BIP Proposal: ML-KEM Key Establishment
recent_posts.summary: - A proposal introduces Hybrid Key Encapsulation using a UG combiner to merge two cryptographic paths.  - The design integrates secp256k1 Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman and ML-KEM-768 for enhanced security.  - This hybrid method ensures robustness, supporting post-quantum readiness and backward compatibility.

recent_posts.title: spscand and libspscan: a watch-only BIP352 scanner
recent_posts.summary: - spscand scans BIP352 silent payment outputs with strong privacy and supports three different block sources.  - libspscan handles receiving logic and filter checks without needing the spend private key, enabling integration.  - Performance is efficient, privacy safeguards are enforced, and all code passes comprehensive tests and reviews.

recent_posts.title: How much BTC sits behind keys or scripts already on chain (block 975,019)
recent_posts.summary: - About 35.6% of Bitcoin's unspent outputs are exposed due to their public keys or scripts.  - Key and hash reuse patterns reveal overlapping usage across multiple output types and encoding formats.  - Reference tables and analysis methods differ from BIP 362 draft definitions, affecting exposure measurements.

recent_posts.title: A STARK proof of Bitcoin's UTXO set at block 972,500, with circuits proven in Lean
recent_posts.summary: - Efficient UTXO snapshot hash computation using Merkle trees and MMR enhances verification scalability.  - Standardized hash formats and restructuring data layers can accelerate UTXO validation and proof generation.  - Per-UTXO Merkle trees enable secure, privacy-preserving proofs, including zero-knowledge methods for reserve verification.

recent_posts.title: Toward Efficient Post-Quantum Bitcoin Bridges
recent_posts.summary: - A garbled-circuit verifier for hash-based STARK proofs achieves post-quantum security and efficient Bitcoin deployment.  - Binary field arithmetic and concise optimization strategies minimize input size, storage needs, and on-chain costs.  - Experimental results show significantly reduced gate counts and storage requirements compared with previous approaches.

active_posts.title: [BIP Proposal] Stale Tip Relay
active_posts.summary: - The `staletip` system helps nodes share information about stale branches and diagnose network issues efficiently.  - Key technical details include message support flags, compressed header sequences, and limitations on shared tip recency.  - Developers seek community feedback to improve implementation and strengthen analysis of block propagation challenges.

active_posts.title: BIP Draft Post-Quantum Address Format (bc1z) using ML-DSA-65
active_posts.summary: - A new `bc1z` Bitcoin address format uses ML-DSA-65 signatures for quantum resistance and enhanced security.  - Backward compatibility is achieved via a soft fork, and a Python implementation offers migration tools.  - The community is invited to review the design, assess migration strategies, and provide feedback on adoption.

active_posts.title: Quantum Landmines and Vulnerable Coin Auctions
active_posts.summary: - Multiple mechanisms, including landmines and auctions, discourage theft of quantum-vulnerable cryptocurrency outputs.  - These approaches employ economic incentives, collateral penalties, and delayed access to strengthen defenses.  - Game theory and adaptive strategies transform quantum vulnerabilities into opportunities for robust security measures.

active_posts.title: Great Consensus Cleanup Revival
active_posts.summary: - The proposal targets Bitcoin protocol vulnerabilities, suggesting improvements for increased security and performance.  - Solutions include fixing the timewarp issue, constraining legacy scripts, and invalidating certain small transactions.  - Debates arise over reducing block size, with community contributions encouraged for collaborative protocol enhancement.

active_posts.title: Towards A K-of-N Lightning Network Node
active_posts.summary: - Nested MuSig2 enables k-of-n multisig with Taproot, improving Lightning Network security and flexibility.  - Implementing these multisig setups faces protocol, privacy, and hardware security challenges requiring significant changes.  - Proposed BOLT protocol updates would allow more flexible multisig, replacing shachain and supporting diverse node configurations.

active_posts.title: Propagation Delay and Mining Centralization: Modeling Stale Rates
active_posts.summary: - Selfish Mining exploits block propagation times, allowing larger miners to increase their revenue advantage.  - Simulation results show even slight differences in propagation times significantly affect mining pool revenues and stale rates.  - Reducing propagation delays could mitigate centralization and promote fairness between mining operations of different sizes.

today_in_history_posts.title: Scaling Lightning With Simple Covenants
today_in_history_posts.summary: - A payment channel model balances trust, safety, and capital efficiency by prepaying cost-of-capital fees.  - Scalability analysis shows high block space requirements and emphasizes minimum leaf values for economic viability.  - A Python program minimizes combined operational costs, highlighting tradeoffs and limitations in long-term onchain processing.

today_in_history_posts.title: Lightning Address in a Bolt 12 world
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Proposed solutions aim to improve privacy and security in the lightning address protocol.  - Two mechanisms are suggested to privately obtain payment information via DNS records and onion messages.  - Only options 1 and 3 should be implemented, with community feedback sought for further enhancement.

today_in_history_posts.title: Thoughts on scaling and consensus changes (2023)
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Bitcoin scalability may rely on 50,000 off-chain entities, including federated sidechains and Chaumian banks.  - Solutions like Coinpools, CTV, and OP_VAULT aim to improve security, efficiency, and exit strategies.  - Networking off-chain entities with strong tools can balance compliance, auditability, and user autonomy.
